caption: Figure 1: Overview of the NEMORI framework. The system comprises two cascading modules guided by three priors: Episodic Memory Integration (top) transforms raw interactions into coherent narrative episodes, and Semantic Knowledge Distillation (bottom) extracts insights via prediction error. The framework can serve as a distillation layer complement native or third-party management systems (right).
